subject: [PATCH v2 07/10] mm/madvise: separate PTE-batch folio processing

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch separates the processing of PTE batches in the madvise function into smaller, more manageable pieces. It moves the per-batch work into a new function called madvise_lru_pte_batch_locked(), which runs under the PTE lock and returns a folio that needs splitting locked and referenced. The lookup of the folio is moved to a separate function called madvise_lru_pte_folio(), and the clearing of young bits in the PTEs is moved to another new function called madvise_cold_ptes(). This patch does not introduce any functional changes, but rather reorganizes the code for better maintainability and efficiency.
